title: Create a Brand Identity Guide from Existing Figma Files
description:
I am looking for a detail-oriented designer to create a comprehensive Brand Identity Packet or Brand Guide for our telemedicine platform, SleepScriptMD.com. 

Please read carefully: There is absolutely no need for any new design changes, rebranding, or creative conceptualization. The visual identity is already fully established. Your job is simply to take our existing design concepts and document them into a clear, professional brand guide.

I will provide 3 Figma files that contain our current website pages and UI designs. 

Your deliverables should include a polished brand guide that extracts and clearly outlines the following from the provided Figma files:

Color palette with specific hex codes and usage rules
Typography guidelines including font families, weights, and sizes for all headings and body text

Logo usage rules and clearances
Standard UI elements like button styles, forms, and spacing
General visual tone based on the provided files

The ideal freelancer has strong attention to detail, experience creating clean and easy-to-read brand documentation. 

If you are interested, please reply with examples of your work and a price for this quick project.

title: WordPress Website Redesign & Optimization for Coaching Business (SEO + Integrations)
description:
WordPress Website Redesign & Optimization for Coaching Business (SEO + Integrations)
Background

I currently have an existing WordPress website for my coaching business, but it is not performing effectively in terms of search visibility, user experience, or conversion.
I am looking for an experienced WordPress designer/developer to refine, redesign, and optimize my existing site, using updated copy, improved structure, and a stronger client journey.

This is not a basic refresh. I want to transform the site into a conversion-focused, SEO-optimized client acquisition tool. This is key.

Current State
•	The website is live, but outdated in structure and performance and some functions not working properly.
•	The messaging and positioning have been updated (new copy will be provided).
•	The site does not currently rank in search results.
•	Client flow (discovery → booking → payment) is currently not optimized.

Project Goals
•	Improve SEO visibility (Google search presence).
•	Create a clean, modern, professional design consistent with branding.
•	Build a clear client journey from landing to booking/payment.
•	Ensure the site is easy for me to update independently.
Scope of Work
•	Review and improve the existing WordPress site structure.
•	Implement new copy and page layouts (provided).
•	Redesign key pages for clarity and conversion.
•	Optimize mobile responsiveness and site speed.
•	Clean up or remove unnecessary plugins/components if needed

Core Pages To Update
•	Home
•	Work With Me (Services)
•	Resume Writing Services
•	About
•	Contact
•	Optional: Blog / Resources

Required Integrations
•	CRM and scheduling via Paperbell
•	Payment processing via Square
•	Lead capture (form integration)

SEO Requirements
I am specifically looking for someone who understands SEO beyond basic plugin setup.

This includes:
•	Keyword-informed page structure
•	Optimization of:
o	Page titles and meta descriptions
o	Header tags (H1, H2, H3)
o	Internal linking
•	SEO-friendly URLs
•	Site speed optimization
•	XML sitemap setup
•	Indexing via Google Search Console
•	Setup of Google Analytics

Key Functionality
•	Clear client journey:

Visitor → Service Page → Booking → Payment
•	Embedded scheduling and/or service purchase
•	Lead capture (consultation or downloadable resource)
•	Easy backend editing (Elementor or similar preferred)

Design Direction
•	Clean, modern, professional
•	Strong use of whitespace
•	Trust-building (career coaching audience)
•	Not overly corporate—approachable and human

Deliverables
•	Fully optimized and redesigned WordPress site
•	All integrations functioning properly
•	SEO foundation implemented
•	Mobile and tablet optimized
•	Editable by me post-launch
•	Basic walkthrough or training

Ideal Experience
•	WordPress redesigns (not just new builds)
•	SEO optimization experience
•	Coaching / service-based business websites
•	Experience with client journey and conversion flow

Final Note
I am not looking for just a visual refresh.
I’m looking for an ongoing partner who can help transform my existing website into a platform that:
•	Gets found (SEO)
•	Builds trust
•	Converts visitors into clients
•	Can help my site evolve as more revenue streams are added

title: Database and Client Support Associate
description:
Small nonprofit-serving consulting firm looking for a Database and Client Support Associate to join our growing team. This is the person who gets quietly excited about clean data. You will spend your time inside donor databases, pulling reports, merging duplicates, building segments, and turning messy CRMs into calm, usable tools our clients can actually trust. It is the kind of work that looks invisible from the outside but holds everything else up.

What You Will Do
-Manage and maintain client CRM systems, primarily Bloomerang
-Run data cleanups, duplicate merges, and ongoing hygiene audits
-Pull reports and build dashboards that help clients make confident decisions
-Conduct prospect research and support wealth screening (DonorSearch and similar)
-Set up moves management fields, tags, custom workflows, and automations
-Build segmented lists for appeals, newsletters, and stewardship touches
-Document processes so clients walk away with systems they actually own
-Support additional client projects as scope grows

Who You Are
-Experienced in Bloomerang (required) and comfortable navigating other donor CRMs like Keela, Little Green Light, DonorPerfect, or GiveButter
-Data-fluent: exports, formulas, and messy spreadsheets do not rattle you
-Detail-oriented without being precious about it
-A clear written communicator who can translate technical work into plain language for clients
-Self-directed, deadline-aware, and steady when things get noisy
-Genuinely invested in the nonprofit sector and the people doing the work

What This Role Looks Like
-Part-time, starting at roughly 40 hours per month
-Flexible schedule. You choose when the work gets done, as long as deadlines are met
-Fully remote
-Strong potential to grow in hours and scope as Sprout expands
-Hourly compensation based on experience
